part.text: I have all the mapping information. Now I can construct the SQL query joining the three tables to get product descriptions for transactions at Czech gas stations.

input.sql:
SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
LIMIT 200

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
